conditions: Same-value donor null (same persona value, different carrier)
Cross-type donor null (non-persona information type, construct-screened)
Rung R1: named persona with pervasive dialect (Captain Marrow, pirate)
Rung R2: named persona with episodic markers (Reginald, butler)
Rung R3: unnamed register (warm, encouraging, informal)
Rung R5: situational user-persona, no style instruction (Lu et al. therapy persona)
Rung R5: situational user-persona, no style instruction (Lu et al. philosophy persona)
metrics: activation fraction-of-swap (F_act, projection onto the pair's own contrast direction)
anchor separation (target descriptor, ceiling minus floor)

figures.title: Specificity ladder: steered vs both nulls per rung
figures.transform: per (direction x slot x arm x rung): pair value = mean F_target over K=5 coherent draws per carrier; rung mean over gate-surviving carriers; carrier-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000, seed 21626); panels install/erase, context-end primary with prefix-end companion; per-rung n and system-prompt token count annotated
figures.plotted_quantity: mean target-descriptor fraction-of-swap F_target (unitless; 0 = floor, 1 = full context swap)

figures.title: Specificity ladder - per-carrier companion
figures.transform: same exclusions as ladder_hero, NO aggregation: one point per gate-surviving (carrier x arm x rung x direction x slot), carrier-labeled, arm-offset

figures.title: Erase vs install asymmetry per rung
figures.transform: per (rung x slot): paired-by-carrier steered erase F_target minus install F_target; per-carrier points plus mean with carrier-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000, seed 21626)
figures.plotted_quantity: paired erase-minus-install difference in F_target (unitless; positive = erasure easier)

figures.title: Anchor separations and gate verdicts per rung
figures.transform: per (rung x carrier) from K=10 anchor draws: target-descriptor separation (ceiling minus floor, 0-1 scale) against the 0.25 bar, and netted dual-rubric separation against the 0.5 bar; pass/fail verdicts marked; ALL rungs rendered including gate failures
figures.plotted_quantity: anchor separation per carrier (target-descriptor scale 0-1; netted scale 0-2)

figures.title: Netted dual-rubric F vs target-only F (rubric-artifact quantification)
figures.transform: per (direction x slot x arm): scatter of netted dual-rubric F (parent metric, x) vs F_target (this round's primary, y), arms color-coded; identity line drawn; quantifies the anti-source-channel inflation measured in Round A (null 0.479 netted vs <=0.003 target-only)
figures.plotted_quantity: F under the two metric conventions (unitless)

figures.title: Continuous-companion agreement: F_act vs F_target and margin validation
figures.transform: panel 1: per (direction x slot x arm) scatter of F_act (y) vs F_target (x) with Spearman rho annotated; panel 2: margin shift vs F_target across cells with dynamic range, Spearman rho (the pre-registered margin validation); panel 3: coherence rate and cap-hit fraction per cell
figures.plotted_quantity: F_act (signed projection, unitless), TF margin shift (nats/token), coherence rate (0-1)

figures.title: Per-conjunct decomposition on R1/R2 steered installs
figures.transform: R1/R2 STEERED rollouts only: mean per-conjunct descriptor score (Round-A conjunct instrument verbatim) beside the holistic target-descriptor score, per direction x slot
